thread:
maria: quick heads-up — we're planning to roll ephemeral svc tokens (bounded, KMS-wrapped) for most internal services next week.

jordan: +1. what's the TTL you're thinking?

maria: default 1h, rotation window 30m. long-lived tokens only for ops-runbooks and k8s controllers that can't do mTLS. aiming to reduce blast radius.

samir: audit question — will Vault audit logs show token mint vs unwrap events? we need those before rollout for compliance.

maria: yes, Vault audit devices will log create, update, and the wrapping unwrap. we'll also enable KMS DEK usage logs. ops-bot: audit-enable vault-audit-devices

ops-bot: Enabled audit device: file at /var/log/vault_audit.json. KMS key usage logging set to customer-kms-1.

elena: RBAC changes: we need a new policy svc/ephemeral-token-producer with path "auth/token/create" limited to service identities. I'll draft Terraform tfvars.

jordan: share the TF snippet you plan to use?

elena: here
```
resource "vault_policy" "ephemeral_producer" {
  name = "svc-ephemeral-producer"
  policy = <<EOT
path "auth/token/create" {
  capabilities = ["create", "read"]
}
EOT
}
```

maria: + request: every rollout must include a short verification playbook. I'll create a minimal one: mint token, call a read-only endpoint, confirm audit logs contain unwrap event, revoke token.

samir: vuln triage note — we still have two services that embed postgres creds in env; rotation of those creds must happen before tokens go live. tagging @platform to schedule.

jordan: timeline?

maria: tentative: freeze config changes Tue, rollout Wed-Thu, full enforcement Mon next week. If anyone needs exceptions ping me.

elena: I'll open an RFC and add the TF diff. ping me if you want to be reviewer.

maria: thanks — will loop security-oncall and compliance. :thumbsup:
